[RFCS.27.2] `FactPublish` is **compare** class ([RFCS.3.4]). A replayer re-derives
it by firing the same rule and compares it against the record ([LFST.9.3.1]); it
**must not** deliver it to the engine as an input. The body holds no value, so a
replay that passes shows that the same rule published the same schema at the same
point, and shows nothing of the values. What crosses a tier is the event's
`FactExternal` ([NCBK.10.1]), which no atom records.
